name: Taj Mahal
description: Peerless white Makrana marble mausoleum on the Yamuna river, an official New 7 Wonder of the World.
history: Commissioned by Emperor Shah Jahan to house the remains of his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal. Built over 22 years by an army of 20,000 artisans under the direction of court architect Ustad Ahmad Lahori.
construction: Crafted from translucent white Makrana marble inlaid with 28 varieties of precious and semi-precious stones (pietra dura technique) and flanked by red sandstone mosques.
architecture: Flawless bilateral symmetry, a central double dome rising 73 meters, four detached minarets angled outward, and a formal Charbagh Persian paradise garden.
significance: Designated an official New 7 Wonder of the World on July 7, 2007 and described by Rabindranath Tagore as 'a teardrop on the cheek of eternity.'
currentStatus: Standing pristine and protected as a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1983.
wonderHistoricalContext: Declared an official New 7 Wonder of the World on July 7, 2007, recognized worldwide as the pinnacle of Indo-Islamic architectural symmetry and devotion.
